تعتطفي (form VIII)
# تَعْتَطِفِي (taʕtaṭifī) /taʕ.ta.tˤi.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# تُعْتَطَفِي (tuʕtaṭafī) /tuʕ.ta.tˤa.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
